correctness.rationale: The identity \(Z_n[p]=a_{1+\nu_2(p)}\) yields a unique highest-marker representation with \(i,j<2^{r-1}\). Equal dyadic shells admit an explicit border translated by \(2^{t+1}\), containing exactly the two local occurrences of \(a_{t+1}\). Unequal shells force any proposed border to occur again after translation by \(-2^{t+1}\) entirely within the longer extension, while zero-side cases are unbordered. Shell squares give \(H_r=(4^{r-1}+2)/3\); summation gives \(C_n=(4^n+6n-1)/9\). Counting ordered pair sums yields the triangular length spectrum. A direct factor/border checker agrees through rank eight, which is diagnostic rather than an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Three relevant primary works and one original-presentation source were compared at theorem/implication level. The general closed-factor bounds, automatic-sequence predicates, and Zimin unique-highest-letter representation do not state or immediately yield the explicit iff criterion that left/right lengths occupy the same dyadic shell, or its exact length spectrum. A broader finite closed-rich extremal asymptotic is compatible, not dominating. Previously available Zimin results on unbordered factors, Lyndon factors, automata and cyclic transforms concern different invariants and do not establish the present closed-factor census. Residual priority risk persists, especially for unindexed theses or specialized literature.
residual_risks: Semantic research-record search is not an exhaustive index of all published mathematical literature.

value.rationale: Closed factors, equivalently complete first returns, are natural invariants in combinatorics on words and compression. The theorem supplies a full iff structural classification for literal finite Zimin words, an exact length-by-length triangular spectrum with systematic dyadic holes, and the exact total \(C_n=(4^n+6n-1)/9\). It produces a concrete quadratic-density \(1/9\) family of words of length \(2^n-1\), without claiming global optimality, and identifies a reusable valuation mechanism rather than an arbitrary numerical increment.
